rationale: Verbose Galaxy run gave per-taxon scores near -30 [24], consistent with the reference median. The agent assumed non-verbose mode reports the median [25] and accepted 146.3023 [27], which those values could not produce. The wrapper's single value was mislabeled.

Off by one DEG (9/49 vs 8/49) [46]. The agent fit ~Group across all 30 samples [28], [29]. The task does not state the design scope, prefiltering or DESeq2 version, so a defensible analysis shifts one gene.

The agent correctly found more DEGs after excluding KL3/WL3 (1479 to 1931) [25], [26] and submitted 'increase' [29]. That means the same as the reference 'Increases the number of DEGs', yet the llm_verifier rejected it.

The Galaxy DESeq2 counts rose from 1479 to 1931, giving direction 'increase' [59], [61]. That matches the reference meaning. The submission broke the label-only format by adding the counts ('1479 1931 increase') [61], [62], which probably caused the rejection.

AIC and adjusted R2 both selected the natural spline; its continuous optimum on the mixtures gave 180771 [5], [7]. Including the endpoints also falls below 184000 [5]. The reference likely assumes an unstated frequency coding, scope or evaluation grid.

A Galaxy UDT fit the spline including the pure endpoints and gave 178984 [29], [30]. The mixtures-only scope also falls below the range. The question leaves frequency coding, data scope and optimization domain unstated, and the reference silently assumes them.

The standard coding definition gave 30/41=0.732, inside the range [35], [55]. The agent then adopted an external script that counts splice_region_variant as coding [46], [59] and submitted 30/47=0.638 [61]. That misclassifies a non-coding Sequence Ontology term.

BUSCO 5.7.1 in protein mode gave 100 shared single-copy BUSCOs [51], [52], against a reference of 101. The task gives no BUSCO or HMMER version. An unvalidated pyhmmer hmmsearch shim [43], [44] may also explain the one-gene difference.

The agent kept the raw DepMap gene-effect sign as 'essentiality' [18], and the most negative rho was CCND1 [23], [25]. The reference CDKN1A implies essentiality is minus gene effect. The question does not state this sign convention.
